verses.pali: … “Evameva kho, bhikkhave, appakā te sattā ye tulākūṭakaṁsakūṭamānakūṭā paṭiviratā; atha kho eteva bahutarā sattā ye tulākūṭakaṁsakūṭamānakūṭā appaṭiviratā …pe….
verses.english: “… the sentient beings who refrain from falsifying weights, metals, or measures are few, while those who don’t refrain are many. …”
